verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents multi-region deployment and a global Anycast network that routes users to the nearest app server. That is request routing to compute the user runs, not a CDN with edge caching for static assets. The evidence pack contains no edge cache, CDN layer, or static-asset caching feature, so the capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve static assets faster using a global CDN with edge caching

citations.quote: your users in Tokyo, São Paulo, or Amsterdam connect to the nearest server through our global Anycast network
